Tigress Reintroduced to Bengal's Buxa Tiger Reserve

A three-year-old tigress, brought from the Valmiki Tiger Reserve, has been released into the Buxa Tiger Reserve in West Bengal. The tigress is reportedly healthy and has settled in, consuming 10kg of meat. Plans are underway to release three more tigers into the reserve by the end of the year.
